sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Mangrove Swamp and Swamp.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Bug moves, water moves, and grass moves are 1.3× stronger.
Smack Down and Thousand Arrows also count as Water for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Brine, Gunk Shot, Hydro Vortex, Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, Muddy Water, Savage Spin-Out, Sludge Wave, Smack Down, and Thousand Arrows: 1.5× stronger.
Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude: weakened to 0.25×.
Explosion, Mind Blown, and Self-Destruct: no effect here.
Poison Powder, Sleep Powder, and Stun Spore: 100% accuracy.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Water-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Speed.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Defense +1 and its ability becomes Clear Body.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
